description: Expander for Fugue, sitting immediately to its right: each voice gains its own step count, wander ceiling, rest pattern and chance of sounding

params.text: Rolls a fresh pitch sequence for the Fugue on each press
Switches whether a voice holds its last note through a rest or a skipped step, or falls silent there
Sets how many of the eight steps that voice plays before it loops, 1 to 8, which is what lets the three voices phase against each other
Sets how far that voice's wander may reach: one, two or five octaves
Sets how many clock ticks that voice rests between active steps: 0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 8, 16, 32, 48 or 64
Sets the chance that a step of that voice actually sounds when it is reached, none to always

inputs.text: A rise rolls a fresh pitch sequence for the Fugue
Changes how many steps that voice plays, added to its steps switch
Changes how far that voice's wander may reach, added to its range switch
Changes how many ticks that voice rests, added to its sleep switch
Changes the chance that a step of that voice sounds, added to its probability knob

outputs.text: The highest of the three voices' current pitches, whichever voice it belongs to
The middle of the three voices' current pitches, whichever voice it belongs to
The lowest of the three voices' current pitches, whichever voice it belongs to
A trigger every time that voice reaches that step

notes: nothing here has any effect until a Fugue is placed immediately to the left; there are no cables between them
the sorted outputs carry the three voices ordered by pitch rather than by name, so they give a bass part, an inner part and a top line instead of three lines that cross
menu: Outputs — a label over the pulse width choice below it
Gate/trigger width — sets how long each per-step trigger lasts: a fixed 1, 2, 5 or 10ms
